description: This file defines a static class 'TransactionContext' that manages transaction information within an Orleans-based application, utilizing AsyncLocal for context storage and providing methods to get, set, and clear transaction info.

classes.name: TransactionContext
classes.description: A static class providing transaction context management using AsyncLocal storage.

methods.name: GetTransactionInfo
methods.description: Returns the current transaction information stored in the context.

methods.name: CurrentTransactionId
methods.description: Property that retrieves the ID of the current transaction, requiring transaction info to be present.

methods.name: GetRequiredTransactionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction info or throws an exception if none is set.

methods.name: SetTransactionInfo
methods.description: Sets the transaction info in the current context if it differs from the existing one.
